After Osmund's crossing, he knows it is time. Stand beside him while he tells Lucan, then help keep the Undercut clear for the barges. |
| [The Fast Barge](../quests/bennet_the_fast_barge.md) | Story | 48 | [Bennet](../npcs/bennet.md) | The fast barge is finished. Bennet needs someone brave enough to run it hard on the Long Reach, over the deepest pool, with Tristan watching from the bank. Ride it to the Heron Pool. |
| [Longjaw](../quests/tristan_longjaw.md) | Story | 48 | [Tristan](../npcs/tristan.md) | The great croc Longjaw followed Bennet's fast barge into the Heron Pool. Defeat it. Bennet's talk takes you to the pool. |
| [Watch, Don't Kill](../quests/constance_watch_not_kill.md) | Story | 50 | [Constance](../npcs/constance.md) | Constance needs the rubble golems on the Spoil Heaps observed, not killed: walk out to three vantage points and watch how they move. |
| [Count Them for Me](../quests/mariota_count_them_for_me.md) | Side | 50 | [Mariota](../npcs/mariota.md) | Mariota wants a count from the Spoil Heaps, for a date she can set beside Theobald's night book of the same weeks. |
| [A New Hearth](../quests/kenric_a_new_hearth.md) | Side | 51 | [Kenric](../npcs/kenric.md) | The hearth lining of Selene's forge has cracked, and Kenric wants it relined before he forges his first sword. Quarry rubble from the Spoil Heaps holds the heat best. |
| [The Quiet Stretch](../quests/leofric_the_quiet_stretch.md) | Side | 51 | [Leofric](../npcs/leofric.md) | Not one report from the quarry road in six weeks, and that worries Leofric more than any red mark. Walk it from the Quarry Landing to the Spoil Heaps. |
| [Stone, Not Stories](../quests/thomasin_stone_not_stories.md) | Side | 51 | [Thomasin](../npcs/thomasin.md) | Thomasin must lecture to the quarrymen's families, who want to know whether the golems are new. She wants real stone on the table, not a story. |
| [A Bounty Alone](../quests/thurstan_a_bounty_alone.md) | Story | 51 | [Thurstan](../npcs/thurstan.md) | Thurstan took a bounty on a Disturbance-touched golem on the Terraced Cuts, and for once Constance refused to come: she wants them watched, not killed. Help him finish it. |
| [Straps Through the Landing](../quests/helewise_straps_through_the_landing.md) | Side | 52 | [Helewise](../npcs/helewise.md) | Helewise's order of leather and shield straps came upriver to the Quarry Landing and sits there. Go to the landing and bring back 20 quarry rubble from the Spoil Heaps, which Vessa will take off the strap price. |
| [Grit for the Furnace](../quests/prudence_grit_for_the_furnace.md) | Side | 52 | [Prudence](../npcs/prudence.md) | Prudence's furnace lining cracked in the last experiment. Golem rubble is the only grit that holds that heat. |
| [The Quarry Village](../quests/wulfric_the_quarry_village.md) | Story | 53 | [Wulfric](../npcs/wulfric.md) | Wulfric's home village is in the quarries upstream, and the stone there has started to stand up. Clear the golems around the Spoil Heaps so the people still there can sleep. |
| [A Stone Run](../quests/merrick_a_stone_run.md) | Side | 54 | [Merrick](../npcs/merrick.md) | Merrick is hiring guards at twice his rate for a stone run up to the quarries, and won't say what he's carrying. Clear the road: 30 monsters on the Spoil Heaps and 30 on the Terraced Cuts. |
| [The Rival at the Gate](../quests/thurstan_the_rival_at_the_gate.md) | Side | 54 | [Thurstan](../npcs/thurstan.md) | Someone has been taking the quarry bounties off the gate board before Thurstan gets there. He wants to beat them to the Spoil Heaps, and asks Roland to judge who did more. |
| [An Impossible Dot](../quests/gervase_an_impossible_dot.md) | Story | 55 | [Gervase](../npcs/gervase.md) | A report puts golems on the Terraced Cuts, far ahead of the line on Gervase's map. It should be impossible. Confirm it. |
| [Whetstones for the Yard](../quests/helewise_whetstones_for_the_yard.md) | Side | 55 | [Helewise](../npcs/helewise.md) | The practice yard is wearing through whetstones. Bring Helewise 25 quarry stone from the Terraced Cuts, then tell Bertrand the new whetstones are coming. |
| [The Mason's Mark](../quests/thomasin_the_masons_mark.md) | Story | 56 | [Thomasin](../npcs/thomasin.md) | The oldest face of the Terraced Cuts carries an Aristocrat mason's mark. Thomasin wants it copied exactly, as a rubbing, not described. |
| [A Present, Unlabelled](../quests/wulfric_a_present_unlabelled.md) | Side | 56 | [Wulfric](../npcs/wulfric.md) | Wulfric wants to give Jocelyn something too good to label: a ledger-weight cut from the fine grey stone of the Terraced Cuts. |
| [The Adventurer's Notes](../quests/mariota_the_adventurers_notes.md) | Story | 57 | [Mariota](../npcs/mariota.md) | An adventurer at the Crooked Lantern keeps notes on every monster she fights. Mariota wants them very badly. Broker a meeting. |
| [The Empty Wagon](../quests/merrick_the_empty_wagon.md) | Side | 57 | [Merrick](../npcs/merrick.md) | One of Merrick's wagons came back from the terraces with its driver and oxen safe and its cargo gone. Find the wagon bed on the Terraced Cuts, clear 40 quarry golems around it, then tell Edric. |
| [A Weak Side for Tobe](../quests/mariota_a_weak_side_for_tobe.md) | Side | 59 | [Mariota](../npcs/mariota.md) | Tobe asked his sister whether golems have a weak side. Mariota would rather he heard it from someone who has fought them. |
| [A Rubbing for Bartholomew](../quests/thomasin_a_rubbing_for_bartholomew.md) | Side | 59 | [Thomasin](../npcs/thomasin.md) | Thomasin wants the golems kept off the old faces while the quarrymen look for more marks, and her rubbing shown to her mentor Bartholomew. |
| [A Golem Core](../quests/ansel_a_golem_core.md) | Story | 60 | [Ansel](../npcs/ansel.md) | Guards from the quarry road come to Ansel bruised as if a wall fell on them. He needs a specimen: the core stones of the Cut Golems of the Deep Cut. |
| [Powdered Golem Stone](../quests/prudence_powdered_golem_stone.md) | Story | 60 | [Prudence](../npcs/prudence.md) | Prudence needs a reagent found only where monsters have moved in: powdered golem stone, for the potion that heals in a moment. |
| [Ore for a First Sword](../quests/kenric_ore_for_a_first_sword.md) | Story | 62 | [Kenric](../npcs/kenric.md) | Selene has judged Kenric ready. His first sword wants iron from the old seam in the Deep Cut, where the quarries' oldest workings are. Gather it. |
| [The Waves](../quests/constance_the_waves.md) | Story | 63 | [Constance](../npcs/constance.md) | Constance wants her notebooks' dates laid against Gervase's monster map, with Mariota reading the pattern: do the changes come in waves, and do the quarries wake at each one? |
| [The Jar That Glows](../quests/prudence_the_jar_that_glows.md) | Side | 64 | [Prudence](../npcs/prudence.md) | One jar of Prudence's powdered golem stone has started to glow on its own. She wants darker stone to compare, and her rival Mirel to see it. |
| [Survey the Quarry Road](../quests/leofric_survey_the_quarry_road.md) | Story | 65 | [Leofric](../npcs/leofric.md) | The waves are real, and Leofric wants the quarry road surveyed again by someone who can defend themselves. Walk the Deep Cut and clear the road through it. |
| [The First Sword](../quests/kenric_the_first_sword.md) | Side | 66 | [Kenric](../npcs/kenric.md) | Kenric's first sword is finished, balanced for a short arm. He wants it tried against something hard before Selene puts her mark beside his: an Elite golem of the Deep Cut. Then tell Wat. |
| [Two Maps Agree](../quests/leofric_two_maps_agree.md) | Side | 66 | [Leofric](../npcs/leofric.md) | Leofric wants his last marks fresh before he compares maps with his old colleague Gervase. Thin the Cut Golems of the Deep Cut, then take his copy to Gervase. |
| [Hold the Deep Cut](../quests/constance_hold_the_deep_cut.md) | Story | 67 | [Constance](../npcs/constance.md) | The wave has come. The Deep Cut's golems are waking all at once. Hold it with Constance while the quarries stand up. |
| [Old Cairn](../quests/edric_old_cairn.md) | Story | 68 | [Edric](../npcs/edric.md) | Something as tall as a house has risen out of the First Cut's face. Ask Edric to take you to the First Cut and defeat Old Cairn, the Ancient of the Quarries. |
| [The Face Is Moving](../quests/edric_the_face_is_moving.md) | Story | 68 | [Edric](../npcs/edric.md) | The quarrymen say the face of the First Cut is moving. Edric wants eyes on it: go to the First Cut's mouth at the far end of the Deep Cut. |

| Quest | Kind | Level | From | Summary |

| [The Cart That Never Came](../quests/the_cart_that_never_came.md) | Side | 10 | [Tobin](../npcs/tobin.md) | A harvest cart left Kaldemor for Bain Harbour along the Verdant Coast Road and never arrived. Walk the road and look for it in the Greenmarsh, then tell Percy, who built it, what you found. |
| [The Snail King](../quests/the_snail_king.md) | Story | 12 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Ranger Hale has heard something huge in a hollow beyond the woods. Walk to Kaldemor Woods, the forest edge past the hills, and tell him what you find. |

| [What the Ledger Says](../quests/what_the_ledger_says.md) | Story | 21 | [Mildred](../npcs/mildred.md) | Mildred's ledger shows the far farms by the woods losing more this year than in any five years before. Ask Elsie why her cows will not graze the far pasture, then defeat 40 Rooting Piglets and Hedge Boars in the Boarwood. |
| [The Wager](../quests/the_wager.md) | Story | 23 | [Percy](../npcs/percy.md) | Percy and Gareth have a wager on what has been gouging the wheels on the Royal Road. Bring Percy 15 Curved Tusks from the Boarwood's boars, and let Gareth look at one first. |
| [The Woodcutter's Sign](../quests/the_woodcutters_sign.md) | Story | 24 | [Orin](../npcs/orin.md) | Forty years ago Orin cut his sign into a great old oak in the woods, the finest tree he left standing. Find it in the deep Boarwood and come back to tell him whether it still stands. |
| [Thinning the Herd](../quests/thinning_the_herd.md) | Story | 26 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Hale's bounty now reaches past the woods. Defeat 60 Tuskers in the deep Boarwood and one Disturbance-touched monster, so the herd stops pushing up toward the farms. |
| [Stilebrook Farm](../quests/stilebrook_farm.md) | Story | 28 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | The herd's wallow is the yard of Stilebrook Farm, an old farm in the deep Boarwood that has stood empty since long before anyone alive. Hale wants to know what keeps the herd there. Reach the farm's old gate. |
| [Hale's Boarwood Bounty](../quests/hales_boarwood_bounty.md) | Repeatable | 28 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Ranger Hale pays a bounty for keeping the Boarwood's herd back from the farms: defeat 40 boars in the Boarwood. He will pay it again, any time. |
| [Too Bold](../quests/too_bold.md) | Story | 30 | [Wilf](../npcs/wilf.md) | Wilf the spore gatherer will not go back into the Deepwood alone: the Hoarder Shrooms on the Humming Trail have grown too bold. Gather 15 Wild Spores from the patches there and defeat 40 Hoarder Shrooms. |
| [Shiny Things](../quests/shiny_things.md) | Story | 32 | [Wilf](../npcs/wilf.md) | The Hoarder Shrooms are carrying shiny things away through the Deepwood. Wilf wants to see what they take: collect 10 Stolen Trinkets from Hoarder Shrooms. |
| [Quietly, for Dottie](../quests/quietly_for_dottie.md) | Story | 34 | [Winnie](../npcs/winnie.md) | Winnie knows Dottie's lamb Button is missing, though Dottie has told no one. Follow the large, round, damp tracks from the bramble at the woods' edge into Windflower Glade, defeat 40 Windflower Caps and find a tuft of speckled wool. Dottie must not learn Winnie sent you. |
| [Roots from Below](../quests/roots_from_below.md) | Story | 36 | [Clem](../npcs/clem.md) | Something strips the roots of Clem's orchard trees nearest the woods, deep underground and only at night. Sit up with him in the orchard, then collect 20 Pale Threads from Bluecaps in the Bluecap Groves. |
| [The Late Pedlar](../quests/the_late_pedlar.md) | Story | 38 | [Molly](../npcs/molly.md) | A travelling pedlar who stops at the Sleepy Snail every summer is three weeks late, and Molly fears the Deepwood. Search the Bluecap Groves for him: defeat 60 Bluecaps and find any sign of him. |
| [Bites That Will Not Close](../quests/bites_that_will_not_close.md) | Story | 40 | [Bess](../npcs/bess.md) | Bess has a page in her count book for bad bites from the woods that will not close. | [The Woodcutters' Hut](../quests/the_woodcutters_hut.md) | Story | 44 | [Molly](../npcs/molly.md) | Past the Bluecap Groves stands the old woodcutters' hut in Breezy Hollow, and Molly thinks Mott could have taken shelter there. Reach the hut, defeat 50 Paleveil Caps around it so whoever is inside can walk out, then talk to Mott. |
| [Home Again](../quests/home_again.md) | Story | 45 | [Dottie](../npcs/dottie.md) | Button is home. Dottie wants to tell her grandmother everything at last, and asks you to come with her. Then Rufus's cat and Molly's pedlar need telling too. |
| [Houses That Will Not Listen](../quests/houses_that_will_not_listen.md) | Story | 46 | [Bertie](../npcs/bertie.md) | Since spring the mushroom houses nearest the woods have leaned away from the trees, and Bertie cannot hear them. Bring him a Paleveil cap from Breezy Hollow. |
| [Where the King Came From](../quests/where_the_king_came_from.md) | Story | 47 | [Garrick](../npcs/garrick.md) | Garrick saw a line of broken treetops leading toward Mano's hollow from somewhere far past the hills. He wants to see where it begins. Climb with him to the top of Breezy Hollow and look out. |
| [The Bluecap Mother](../quests/the_bluecap_mother.md) | Story | 48 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | The Bluecaps, the pale threads, the leaning houses: Hale thinks they all come from one place in the Deepwood. Reach the mouth of the Bluecap Hollow, at the foot of Breezy Hollow, and come back. |
| [Spores for Two](../quests/spores_for_two.md) | Repeatable | 30 | [Wilf](../npcs/wilf.md) | Wilf supplies Rosa and Bram both, and they both want more. Bring him 20 Wild Spores from the patches of the Deepwood. He will take more, any time. |
| [Follow Her Home](../quests/follow_her_home.md) | Story | 50 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Ranger Hale has noticed Meg ranging past the far end of the Deepwood. He asks you to follow her quietly, past Breezy Hollow to the old road beyond, and make sure she comes home. |
| [A Dare](../quests/a_dare.md) | Story | 50 | [Meg](../npcs/meg.md) | Meg caught you following her. She makes it a dare: stand in the clearing on the Keep Road with her watching, and defeat 60 Capguards. |
| [The Cloud That Didn't Move](../quests/the_cloud_that_didnt_move.md) | Story | 52 | [Nell](../npcs/nell.md) | Nell has shown you a page of her tally book: a grey cloud over the woods that did not move. Bring her 20 Spore Puff wisps from Stonecap Keep so she can see what it was made of. |
| [Up the Walls](../quests/up_the_walls.md) | Story | 54 | [Garrick](../npcs/garrick.md) | Garrick wants to know what can be seen from the top of Stonecap Keep. Climb to the highest point of the Battlements, the old lookout over the first wall. |
| [Shiny Things, Found](../quests/shiny_things_found.md) | Story | 56 | [Wilf](../npcs/wilf.md) | Wilf always wanted to know where the Shrooms were carrying their shiny things. The answer is up the walls of Stonecap Keep. Collect 20 Stolen Trinkets from the Hoarder Shrooms on the Battlements. |
| [Brass and Tin](../quests/brass_and_tin.md) | Story | 57 | [Mott](../npcs/mott.md) | Mott the pedlar has heard where his stolen wares went. Recover 15 pieces of Pedlar's Tinware from the Hoarder Shrooms of Stonecap Keep. |
| [Old Wall Iron](../quests/the_old_wall_iron.md) | Story | 58 | [Gareth](../npcs/gareth.md) | Gareth has seen the iron coming out of Stonecap Keep's walls. Bring him 30 pieces of Old Wall Iron from the Crowncaps of the Inner Ward, and he will forge the next tier of equipment from it. |
| [A Draught for the Dust](../quests/a_draught_for_the_dust.md) | Story | 60 | [Bram](../npcs/bram.md) | The dust of Stonecap Keep is giving the hunters who come back from it a cough. Bram wants 25 Spore Puff sacs to work out a draught for it, and will teach you the recipe. |
| [The Old Wall's Marks](../quests/the_old_walls_marks.md) | Story | 61 | [Lottie](../npcs/lottie.md) | Lottie has heard there are masons' marks on the stones of Stonecap Keep. Copy the marks on the keep's gate and on the west and east towers of the Battlements for her notebook. |
| [The Inner Ward](../quests/the_inner_ward.md) | Story | 63 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Hale wants the way through the Inner Ward of Stonecap Keep cleared before anyone goes further. Defeat 100 Wallcreeper Caps and Crowncaps, and 3 of them that are Disturbance-touched. |
| [Meg's Count](../quests/megs_count.md) | Story | 66 | [Meg](../npcs/meg.md) | Meg is keeping count in the Inner Ward, and she wants your number in her book next to hers. Defeat 150 of the Inner Ward's Wallcreeper Caps and Crowncaps. |
| [What Drove It Out](../quests/what_drove_it_out.md) | Story | 68 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Hale has wondered all year what drove old Mano out of the woods. The answer is at the top of Stonecap Keep. Reach the foot of the Crown Tower at the far end of the Inner Ward. |
| [Said Out Loud](../quests/said_out_loud.md) | Story | 70 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Bring the Cap King down at the top of the Crown Tower, then go and see Meg: Hale has something he wants her to hear. |
| [The Keep Bounty](../quests/the_keep_bounty.md) | Repeatable | 55 | [Hale](../npcs/hale.md) | Ranger Hale pays a bounty for keeping Stonecap Keep in hand: defeat 80 monsters on the Battlements or in the Inner Ward. He will pay it again, any time. |

## Midbarium

|---|---|---|---|---|

| [The Canyon Cairns](../quests/ennek_the_canyon_cairns.md) | Side | 15 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | The Tolmach mark the canyon road with cairns, and Ennek wants three of them checked. Hunt 30 Dust Boggles while you are down there. |
| [Sure Footing](../quests/ennek_sure_footing.md) | Side | 20 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | Ennek teaches the Tolmach way of walking ledges to those who will follow him along the narrowest ledges of the South Path. Walk behind him, three ledges, and learn Sure Footing. |
| [The North Ridge Patrol](../quests/skarra_north_ridge_patrol.md) | Side | 16 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Skarra sends a patrol over the North Ridge every day, and today it is short a pair of hands. Hunt 40 Ridge Stumps on the North Ridge and report at the Trail Watch post. |
| [Letters to the East](../quests/odda_letters_to_the_east.md) | Side | 17 | [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md) | Odda writes to an old friend in Fairy Forest each spring, and the letters go east along the Northern Woodland Trail. Hunt 40 Edge Lizards in the Edgewood so they get there. |
| [The Trail Watch Bounty](../quests/skarra_trail_watch_bounty.md) | Repeatable | 15 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty to anyone who keeps the roads clear: 50 of the roads' monsters, any time. |
| [Walk the Patrols](../quests/hask_walk_the_patrols.md) | Story | 20 | [Hask](../npcs/old_one_hask.md) | The Old One asks you, who belong to none of the four families, to walk the trail watch's patrols and tell him the truth about them. Go to Skarra on the Uskari Rim. |
| [Red Dots](../quests/skarra_red_dots.md) | Story | 20 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Skarra marks every sighting on her hide map with a red dot. Reach the newest dots on Windworn Hill and the Long Ridge, and hunt 40 Gnarled Stumps on Windworn Hill. |
| [A Safe Pasture](../quests/sennu_a_safe_pasture.md) | Story | 22 | [Sennu](../npcs/sennu_tolmach.md) | Sennu has kept the herds close to town all summer, and the near ground is eaten to the root. Scout the high pasture on the Long Ridge and clear 50 monsters there. |
| [A Word for Tavi](../quests/sennu_word_for_tavi.md) | Story | 22 | [Sennu](../npcs/sennu_tolmach.md) | Sennu needs the trail watch on the ridge path the morning the herds go up, but she and Tavi will not speak to each other. Carry her word to Tavi. |
| [Three Goats' Tracks](../quests/yarrek_three_goats.md) | Story | 23 | [Yarrek](../npcs/yarrek_tolmach.md) | Last month three of Yarrek's goats strayed down a gully below the Long Ridge and came home wild. Follow their old tracks and hunt 40 Axe Stumps in what they ran from. |
| [The Worst Stretch](../quests/tavi_the_worst_stretch.md) | Story | 25 | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) | Tavi walks the worst stretch of the patrols personally: out along the Broken Ground to the far canyon bridge. Walk it together, look at the bridge, and hunt 60 Dark Axe Stumps on the way. |
| [Old Gnarl](../quests/tavi_old_gnarl.md) | Story | 28 | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) | The oldest of the ridge trees, Old Gnarl, has rooted on Howling Peak, and the stumps of the ridges grow thick around it. Tavi will take you up. End it. |
| [The High Pasture](../quests/mabbu_the_high_pasture.md) | Story | 28 | [Sennu](../npcs/sennu_tolmach.md) | The ridge pasture can be used again, and Mabbu wants to see it with her own eyes, though she has not climbed that far since her knees gave out. Walk her up slowly to the high pasture on the Long Ridge. |
| [The First Report](../quests/hask_the_first_report.md) | Story | 29 | [Hask](../npcs/old_one_hask.md) | You have walked the High Ridges from the North Ridge to Howling Peak. Tell the Old One the truth about them. |
| [Wood for the Fire](../quests/ulm_wood_for_the_fire.md) | Side | 21 | [Ulm](../npcs/ulm_kragvar.md) | Ulm has kept the council fire for forty years and never let it burn low. Bring him 30 Dark Bark from the ridges, which burns slow and hot. |
| [Wedges for the Scaffold](../quests/dorrek_wedges_for_the_scaffold.md) | Side | 24 | [Dorrek](../npcs/dorrek_kragvar.md) | Dorrek climbs the highest scaffold himself before any mason goes up, and he wants it wedged tight. Bring him 30 Ridge Bark for wedges. |
| [The Cistern Count](../quests/gorra_the_cistern_count.md) | Side | 21 | [Gorra](../npcs/gorra_kragvar.md) | Gorra keeps the stone cisterns that water the terraces, and it is time for her count. Check the four cisterns on the west terraces for her. |
| [A Stair of Her Own](../quests/brakka_a_stair_of_her_own.md) | Side | 22 | [Brakka](../npcs/brakka_kragvar.md) | Brakka dreams of carving the first new stairway down the cliff in a hundred years. Bring her 25 Dark Bark for her trial wedges, and look at the bare cliff on the Long Ridge where the stair's rock comes out of the mountain. |
| [The Tallest Ledge](../quests/korrin_the_tallest_ledge.md) | Side | 20 | [Korrin](../npcs/korrin_kragvar.md) | Korrin swears the trail watch's scouts climb to the very top ledge of the North Ridge. Climb there and tell him what you can see. |
| [New Lashings](../quests/vosk_new_lashings.md) | Side | 26 | [Vosk](../npcs/vosk_kragvar.md) | Twice this season Vosk has found the far canyon bridge's ropes gnawed half through. He is doubling the lashings at the anchors and needs stakes: bring him 20 Giant Firewood. |
| [Where Did You Come From?](../quests/kesh_where_did_you_come_from.md) | Side | 20 | [Kesh](../npcs/kesh_tolmach.md) | Kesh asks everyone where they came from and what the road was like. Walk down to the Canyon Road so you can tell him properly. |
| [The Hard Bargain](../quests/harra_the_hard_bargain.md) | Side | 30 | [Harra](../npcs/harra_tolmach.md) | Fewer lowland traders make the climb every year, and Harra means to make the ones who come pay well. Bring her 20 Wild Boar Teeth, which the lowlanders prize. |
| [Twisted Wood](../quests/zirra_twisted_wood.md) | Side | 30 | [Zirra](../npcs/zirra_uskari.md) | Zirra's best staves come from twisted trees, and her stock is at its lowest in a lifetime. Bring her the Gnarlwood that Old Gnarl drops. |
| [Spring Letters](../quests/odda_spring_letters.md) | Side | 30 | [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md) | Odda's letter to her old friend in Fairy Forest is sealed. Take it to Corwell for the next caravan east. |
| [The Ridge Bounty](../quests/skarra_ridge_bounty.md) | Repeatable | 21 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty for the High Ridges: 60 of the ridges' stumps, any time. |
| [Touched on the Ridges](../quests/skarra_ridge_elites.md) | Repeatable | 22 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Some of the ridges' stumps are Disturbance-touched: bigger, harder and shimmering. Skarra pays well for each one put down. |
| [The Second Stick](../quests/kesh_the_second_stick.md) | Story | 30 | [Kesh](../npcs/kesh_tolmach.md) | Kesh keeps two notched sticks: one for eagles, one for things he cannot name. Ask Korrin about the two notches on the second. |
| [The Boys' Lookout](../quests/korrin_the_lookout.md) | Story | 30 | [Korrin](../npcs/korrin_kragvar.md) | Korrin and Kesh have a lookout above the terraces nobody knows about. Look out from it, then go and look at the far canyon bridge up close on the Broken Ground. |
| [What Hallek Did Not See](../quests/hallek_the_bite.md) | Story | 31 | [Hallek](../npcs/hallek_kragvar.md) | Hallek, the mason bitten on the far canyon bridge this spring, will tell what bit him, or what little there was to see. Take the account to Lessa. |
| [What Bites](../quests/lessa_what_bites.md) | Story | 32 | [Lessa](../npcs/lessa_brenna.md) | Lessa wants to know the beast behind the bites she treats. Hunt 30 Cliff Gnawers at the Far Anchor and bring her 10 Gnawed Rope Ends so she can match the teeth. |
| [The Night Watch](../quests/vosk_the_night_watch.md) | Story | 33 | [Vosk](../npcs/vosk_kragvar.md) | Vosk will keep watch on the far canyon bridge after dark, with Brakka and with you. Hold the anchors at the Far Anchor through the night. |
| [Fresh Cable](../quests/corwell_fresh_cable.md) | Story | 34 | [Corwell](../npcs/corwell.md) | Corwell has a coil of fresh lowland cable for Vosk. Carry it to him, and clear 50 Wild Boars from around the anchor stakes at the Far Anchor before the next gnawing. |
| [Grey and Bitter](../quests/lessa_rimwort.md) | Story | 35 | [Lessa](../npcs/lessa_brenna.md) | Lessa's rimwort is nearly gone, and the Uskari have not brought any home since the hunts stopped. Gather 15 Rimwort on the Far Slopes and take it to Odda to dry. |
| [A Message for the Old One](../quests/zirra_a_message_for_hask.md) | Story | 36 | [Zirra](../npcs/zirra_uskari.md) | Zirra has a message for Hask that she would rather die than deliver herself. Carry it to him, and hunt 60 Scarred Boars on the way. |
| [The Split Drum](../quests/thrun_the_split_drum.md) | Story | 37 | [Thrun](../npcs/thrun_brenna.md) | The great drum's hide has split and only a great horned beast's hide could replace it. Thrun asks only that Vosk check the drum's stand. |
| [Wide Tracks](../quests/skarra_wide_tracks.md) | Story | 39 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Goats are being taken from the edges of the herds. Inspect three raider tracks on the Ironback Flats for Skarra, and hunt 60 Flint Hogs there. |
| [The Raider](../quests/bekk_the_raider.md) | Story | 42 | [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md) | Bekk wants to track the herd raider, and his mother has forbidden him to go alone. You agreed to go with him at first light, but at dawn he was gone. Tell Skarra. |
| [Find Bekk](../quests/skarra_find_bekk.md) | Story | 42 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Bekk went after the raider alone. Find him on the Hot Rocks and get him out: hunt 40 Iron Boars, then see him home. |
| [Follow the Tracks](../quests/bekk_follow_the_tracks.md) | Story | 46 | [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md) | This time Bekk goes with leave, and with you. Follow the raider's tracks over the Hot Rocks (three places) and clear 80 Iron Boars from the way. |
| [Grimhorn](../quests/bekk_grimhorn.md) | Story | 48 | [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md) | The raider is Grimhorn, a great horned beast on the Ash Mesa. Bekk waits at the edge; the fight is yours alone. Defeat it and bring Grimhorn's Hide to Thrun. |
| [The New Hide](../quests/thrun_the_new_hide.md) | Story | 48 | [Thrun](../npcs/thrun_brenna.md) | Vosk and Thrun will fit Grimhorn's hide to the great drum. Fetch Vosk to the hall, then come back to Thrun for the drum's first beat. |
| [The Second Report](../quests/hask_the_second_report.md) | Story | 49 | [Hask](../npcs/old_one_hask.md) | The far bridge is held and the herds are safe from the raider, for now. Report to Hask. |
| [The Wild Goats](../quests/yarrek_the_wild_goats.md) | Side | 40 | [Yarrek](../npcs/yarrek_tolmach.md) | Yarrek's three wild goats still bite and will not eat from his hand. Bring him 15 Rimwort to try on them. |
| [Back on the Bridge](../quests/hallek_back_on_the_bridge.md) | Side | 40 | [Hallek](../npcs/hallek_kragvar.md) | Hallek is ready to go back to work on the far canyon bridge, if the gnawers are fewer. Hunt 60 Cliff Gnawers at the Far Anchor. |
| [Old Verses](../quests/ahvi_old_verses.md) | Side | 45 | [Ahvi](../npcs/ahvi_brenna.md) | Ahvi is troubled by an old verse about beasts growing wild. Ask Odda and Thrun what verses they remember from the oldest part of the long songs. |
| [The Herds Go Out](../quests/sennu_the_herds_go_out.md) | Side | 46 | [Sennu](../npcs/sennu_tolmach.md) | With the bridge held, Sennu wants to take the herds out to the old far pastures. Hunt 80 Wild Boars on the Boar Runs before they go. |
| [More Bites](../quests/lessa_more_bites.md) | Side | 44 | [Lessa](../npcs/lessa_brenna.md) | Lessa is setting more bones than ever, and her splints keep cracking. Bring her 20 Iron Boar Armor plates from the Hot Rocks to bind them. |
| [Kragvar Stone](../quests/dorrek_kragvar_stone.md) | Side | 40 | [Dorrek](../npcs/dorrek_kragvar.md) | The masons wear out their hammers on the hard Kragvar stone. Bring Dorrek 30 Flint Hooves to make new hammer heads. |
| [A Quiet Word](../quests/hask_a_quiet_word.md) | Side | 35 | [Hask](../npcs/old_one_hask.md) | Hask wants to know what the families would say about the patrols, if he asked them in council. Have a quiet word with Zirra, Ulm and Odda. |
| [Far Slopes Bounty](../quests/bekk_slope_bounty.md) | Repeatable | 31 | [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md) | Bekk pays a Trail Watch bounty for 80 monsters of the Far Slopes, gnawers, boars and hogs alike. He will pay it again, any time. |
| [Far Slopes Elites](../quests/bekk_slope_elites.md) | Repeatable | 32 | [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md) | Now and then a beast of the Far Slopes is touched by the Disturbance and grows fiercer. Bekk pays well for each such Elite brought down. |
| [The Greywater](../quests/ennek_the_greywater.md) | Story | 50 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | Ennek has something to show you halfway down the South Path, at the Greywater Cleft. Go and look at the spring. |
| [Tell Your Mother](../quests/ennek_tell_your_mother.md) | Story | 50 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | Ennek has to tell Sennu that the Greywater is dry, before somebody else does. Go with him to her tent in the Tolmach Camps. |
| [The Old Springs](../quests/mabbu_the_old_springs.md) | Story | 52 | [Mabbu](../npcs/mabbu_tolmach.md) | Mabbu remembers every spring that ran in the driest year. Check three old springs on the Dry Hills and hunt 80 Swollen Stumps there. |
| [A Shimmering Night](../quests/imre_a_shimmering_night.md) | Story | 53 | [Imre](../npcs/imre.md) | Imre wants you on the highest terrace on a shimmering night, to see what Imre sees, and then out on the Weathered Rocks, where a dry storm is breaking. |
| [Dates and Dots](../quests/tavi_dates_and_dots.md) | Story | 54 | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) | Imre left a book of dates with Tavi, and Tavi laid it beside Skarra's hide map. Carry Imre's book to Ahvi in the Brenna House. |
| [Hold the Old Camp](../quests/skarra_hold_the_old_camp.md) | Story | 55 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | Skarra wants a Trail Watch post at the Old War Camp. Clear 100 monsters on the Weathered Rocks, then reach the camp. |
| [New Staves](../quests/zirra_new_staves.md) | Story | 56 | [Zirra](../npcs/zirra_uskari.md) | Zirra needs new bow staves, and the canyon valleys are closed to her. Bring her 10 Sound Staves cut from the Swollen Stumps of the Dry Hills. |
| [The Old Walls](../quests/brakka_the_old_walls.md) | Story | 58 | [Brakka](../npcs/brakka_kragvar.md) | Brakka wants to know how the first Kragvar cut stone. Inspect three old walls in the War Camp Ruins and hunt 100 War Masks or Bone Hounds. |
| [Follow the Springs](../quests/ennek_follow_the_springs.md) | Story | 62 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | The dying springs lead west and down. Go to the Red Ravine, look closely at three of the roots that run into the rock, and hunt 100 Stone Hulks. |
| [The Rootdrinker](../quests/ennek_the_rootdrinker.md) | Story | 66 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | In a hollow under the Red Ravine, a vast dead tree is drinking the highland springs dry. Ennek knows the way down: clear the Rootdrinker. |
| [The Greywater Runs](../quests/ennek_the_greywater_runs.md) | Story | 68 | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) | Go and look at the Greywater Cleft again. Then tell Sennu, and take the news to Mabbu. |
| [The Verse](../quests/odda_the_verse.md) | Story | 68 | [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md) | Ahvi has waited all summer for Odda's word on whether to sing her old verse at a gathering. Hear Odda out, then take her answer to Ahvi. |
| [The Gathering](../quests/hask_the_gathering.md) | Story | 69 | [Hask](../npcs/old_one_hask.md) | Hask has called the four families to the Great Hall. Hear Thrun's drum and Ahvi's verse, then sit in council and tell the Old One the truth he asked you for. |
| [By the Fire](../quests/ulm_by_the_fire.md) | Side | 60 | [Ulm](../npcs/ulm_kragvar.md) | Ulm wants someone to sit up by the council fire with him tonight. What he says there, he will not say in council: carry it to Hask. |
| [The Old North Stair](../quests/dorrek_the_old_north_stair.md) | Side | 55 | [Dorrek](../npcs/dorrek_kragvar.md) | Dorrek wants the patch on the old north stair checked, where his uncle Baruk fell. Inspect it on the North Ridge. |
| [The Founders' Trickle](../quests/gorra_the_founders_trickle.md) | Side | 60 | [Gorra](../npcs/gorra_kragvar.md) | Gorra can hear water running somewhere under the Founders' Cistern. Follow the trickle down the terraces and bring her 20 Swollen Wood to seal the leak. |
| [The Long Song](../quests/neffa_the_long_song.md) | Side | 50 | [Neffa](../npcs/neffa_brenna.md) | Neffa always stumbles on the same verse of the long song: Old One Varra's. Ask Ahvi, Thrun and Odda what Varra was like, and bring their answers back to Neffa. |
| [A Name in the Song](../quests/neffa_a_name_in_the_song.md) | Side | 60 | [Neffa](../npcs/neffa_brenna.md) | Deep in the oldest part of the long song is a chieftain who held the western edge 'behind a wall of faces'. Bring Neffa a Carved War Mask Shard from the War Camp Ruins and tell her what it was. |
| [The Beast Verse](../quests/ahvi_the_beast_verse.md) | Side | 62 | [Ahvi](../npcs/ahvi_brenna.md) | Ahvi wants to know whether her old verse about beasts grown wild is true. Hunt 60 Bone Hounds in the War Camp Ruins and tell her what you saw. |
| [Star Verses](../quests/imre_star_verses.md) | Side | 58 | [Imre](../npcs/imre.md) | Imre is quietly gathering the Brenna names for the stars. Ask Ahvi, Thrun and Neffa what they call them, and do not say what it is for. |
| [Withered Reach Bounty](../quests/tavi_reach_bounty.md) | Repeatable | 51 | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) | Tavi pays a bounty for every hundred monsters of the Withered Reach, and will pay it again any time. |
| [Withered Reach Elites](../quests/tavi_reach_elites.md) | Repeatable | 52 | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) | Tavi pays for every Elite of the Withered Reach brought down: the stirred ones, bigger and meaner than their kind. |
| [A Withered Reach Epic](../quests/tavi_reach_epic.md) | Repeatable | 55 | [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md) | Now and then the Reach throws up something far worse than an Elite. Tavi pays well for every Epic brought down. |
| [The Canyon Stretch](../quests/skarra_the_canyon_stretch.md) | Story | 20 | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) | There is a stretch of the watch's canyon trail Ketta will not walk. Go to the head of the rope-way at the east edge of the Uskari Rim and look down at it. |
| [Earn Her Trust](../quests/ketta_earn_her_trust.md) | Story | 20 | [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md) | Ketta goes quiet whenever the cave comes up. Bring her 20 Boggle Dust and a Goat Cheese, and maybe she will talk. |
| [Let Ketta Lead](../quests/tavi_let_ketta_lead.md) | Story | 21 | [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md) | Ketta has decided to tell Tavi about the cave herself. Go with her to Tavi. |
| [Back into the Dark](../quests/ketta_back_into_the_dark.md) | Story | 22 | [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md) | Ketta is ready to see the cave again. Go down into the Dustfall Cave with her, as far as the Cold Draught. |
| [A Venom Gland](../quests/lessa_a_venom_gland.md) | Story | 24 | [Lessa](../npcs/lessa_brenna.md) | Lessa has been cleaning drake bites from the watch's canyon trail and guessing at each one. Bring her 5 Drake Venom Glands from the Frost Drakes of the Chill Caves. |
| [Hollowmaw](../quests/ketta_hollowmaw.md) | Story | 25 | [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md) | At the bottom of the Dustfall Cave, the great drake Ketta saw rules a lake in the dark. Go down with her and clear the cave, Hollowmaw and all. |
| [The Cave Is Held](../quests/ketta_the_cave_is_held.md) | Story | 25 | [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md) | Hollowmaw is dead. Go with Ketta to tell Tavi that the Dustfall Cave is held. |
| [Drakes of the Dustfall](../quests/ketta_cave_drakes.md) | Repeatable | 22 | [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md) | The drakes of the Dustfall Cave keep breeding. Ketta pays for every 60 brought down, any time. |

| [The Aristocrat Lock](../quests/hex_the_aristocrat_lock.md) | Story | 20 | [Hex](../npcs/hex_dunmore.md) | The Open Table has agreed to open the iron door under the Great Hall, but nobody has ever opened its Aristocrat lock. | [Good Rope](../quests/rivet_good_rope.md) | Side | 21 | [Rivet](../npcs/rivet.md) | Good rope from outside is getting scarce, and Rivet's lift runs on rope. Twisted adder skin makes a strong cord: bring Rivet 25 Adder Skins. |
| [Roofs to Avoid](../quests/nana_roofs_to_avoid.md) | Side | 21 | [Nana Gristle](../npcs/nana_gristle.md) | Nana Gristle warned Kite about the rotten gutter on the north end of the long roof over the Night Market. Kite jumped it anyway, and something happened. Nana wants Kite to admit she was right. |
| [Salve Base](../quests/ivo_salve_base.md) | Side | 21 | [Ivo Sable](../npcs/ivo_sable.md) | The salves that come in from outside are scarce, so Ivo is making his own. Cold seep toad spawn makes a cooling base for burn salve: bring Ivo 20 Seep Toad Spawn. |
| [A Washtub](../quests/drum_a_washtub.md) | Side | 21 | [Drum](../npcs/drum.md) | Drum wants something bigger and louder to beat on. Hambone, at the Old Barracks Yard, has an old washtub from the theatre. |

| [New Panes](../quests/tinsel_new_panes.md) | Story | 23 | [Tinsel](../npcs/tinsel.md) | The outer lanterns have lost their glass. Carry a crate of Tinsel's new panes from the furnace through the crowded Night Market to Lux before the outer lanterns go dark. |
| [The Secret Drawings](../quests/bolt_the_secret_drawings.md) | Side | 23 | [Bolt](../npcs/bolt.md) | Bolt has one question about counterweights that only Rivet can answer, and cannot bear to ask it himself. Ask Rivet for him, without saying why. |
| [The Well Winch](../quests/rivet_the_well_winch.md) | Side | 23 | [Rivet](../npcs/rivet.md) | Leland's old well shaft drops straight into Low Grad, and Rivet wants to rig a rope winch down it. Bring 15 more Adder Skins for the line, and ask Leland where the shaft can take the bolts. |

Ferro will forge an iron grate for the Watch to set across it, but needs red clay for the forge: bring 15 Clods of Red Earth. |
| [Jinx Checks the Bucket](../quests/jinx_checks_the_bucket.md) | Side | 24 | [Jinx](../npcs/jinx.md) | Before Tinder's show tonight, Jinx filled and checked Tinder's water bucket, three times, the way Tinder does. Now Jinx wants to know whether Tinder noticed, and cannot bear to ask. |
| [Lamp Oil](../quests/tinder_lamp_oil.md) | Side | 24 | [Tinder](../npcs/tinder.md) | Tinder's fire-eating fuel smokes and stings. Lampbat wings are waxy with the oil of the lanterns they swarm; pressed, they give a clean-burning oil. Bring Tinder 20 Lampbat Wings. |
| [A Chip of Warm Stone](../quests/tinsel_a_chip_of_warm_stone.md) | Story | 25 | [Tinsel](../npcs/tinsel.md) | Tinsel wants the chip of warm stone from the Warm Quarry for the glowing-glass experiments. Bring it to the furnace on Workshops Row. |
| [The Awl by the Door](../quests/cobble_the_awl_by_the_door.md) | Side | 25 | [Cobble](../npcs/cobble.md) | Cobble left a scrap of hide and an awl by the shop door to see what Edgar would do with them. Both are gone. Cobble will not ask Edgar; you can. |
| [The Rhythm Outside](../quests/drum_the_rhythm_outside.md) | Story | 26 | [Drum](../npcs/drum.md) | For the first time, Drum plays the monster-rhythm outside the gate, on the Outworks' edge. Hunt the lampbats in the outer ditch while it plays, and see whether they scatter. |
| [A Tune for the Outer Wall](../quests/saffi_a_tune_for_the_outer_wall.md) | Side | 27 | [Saffi](../npcs/saffi_quell.md) | Saffi wants her tenth street tune to be the Outer Wall, but has never heard what the Outworks sound like at dusk. Go out to the Outer Ditch and listen for her. |
| [The Rain Rule](../quests/figgy_the_rain_rule.md) | Side | 28 | [Figgy](../npcs/figgy.md) | Someone told Figgy that a drawing washed away by rain is a drawing ruined, not finished. Figgy wants the matter judged properly, by Nana Gristle, who judges everything. |
| [Testing Springs](../quests/bolt_testing_springs.md) | Side | 29 | [Bolt](../npcs/bolt.md) | Bolt set a row of test spring-traps along the outer ditch to see how springs hold up in the damp. The ditch rats keep setting them off and making off with the bait. Clear 40 of them so the test counts. |
| [A Wall for Figgy](../quests/ochre_a_wall_for_figgy.md) | Side | 30 | [Ochre](../npcs/ochre.md) | Ochre has secretly found a wall for Figgy: the low wall under the Fiddler's Crossing, right below one of Splash's bridges. | [The Middle of the Square](../quests/tinder_the_middle_of_the_square.md) | Side | 30 | [Tinder](../npcs/tinder.md) | Tinder wants to play one big show right in the middle of Lantern Square, the biggest in years. | [A Letter Home](../quests/edgar_a_letter_home.md) | Side | 31 | [Edgar Penhallow](../npcs/alder_penhallow.md) | Edgar is writing his report home to the guild, and it must be exact about the rooftop boot. He needs one detail of the sole from Cobble. |

| [The Thin Whistler](../quests/saffi_the_thin_whistler.md) | Side | 33 | [Saffi](../npcs/saffi_quell.md) | A thin person with a tin whistle haunts the edge of Lantern Square whenever Saffi plays, and never plays a note. Saffi wants to know why. The whistler is Piper, the troupe's songwriter. |

| [The Newest Lens](../quests/tinsel_the_newest_lens.md) | Story | 54 | [Tinsel](../npcs/tinsel.md) | Kite is laid up, and Starling needs Tinsel's newest lens tonight. Carry it up through the crowded evening streets to Starling's roof. |

| [The Crooked Tower Run](../quests/kite_the_crooked_tower_run.md) | Side | 26 | [Kite](../npcs/kite.md) | Kite dreams of a run from the top of the Crooked Tower to the fortress gate without touching a stair. Run the line first, while Kite times it from outside. |

| [The Grandee's Fall](../quests/sprout_the_grandees_fall.md) | Side | 31 | [Sprout](../npcs/sprout.md) | Sprout once did the grandee's fall off the Great Hall's table and landed on his elbow. Ask Dex how to do it properly, loudly, while Sprout listens from behind the curtain. |

| [The Walker Stars](../quests/starling_the_walker_stars.md) | Side | 35 | [Starling](../npcs/starling.md) | Starling's old star chart has the Walkers' names for the stars, but one name has faded away. Ozzie Lantry knows the Walkers' songs; perhaps one of them knows the stars. |

| [Lark's Song](../quests/dex_larks_song.md) | Side | 40 | [Dex](../npcs/dex.md) | On her day each year, Dex and Sprout sing one of Lark's songs on the Rooftops, and this year Dex lost the middle verse. Piper writes everything down; ask about the swallow song. |
| [Play with Saffi](../quests/piper_play_with_saffi.md) | Side | 40 | [Piper](../npcs/piper.md) | Saffi has heard the whistle parts Piper wrote for her street tunes, and now Piper cannot go near Lantern Square. Ask Saffi whether Piper may play with her, once. |

| [Scrap and the Roads](../quests/vane_scrap_and_the_roads.md) | Side | 44 | [Vane](../npcs/vane.md) | Scrap has started asking about the roads, and Vane cannot test a road by jumping on it. Ask Shade at the Gate Walk what Scrap is really learning. |
| [A New Comedy](../quests/pip_a_new_comedy.md) | Side | 45 | [Pip Marrow](../npcs/pip_marrow.md) | Pip is writing a new comedy she will show nobody, and she needs something only Ozzie Lantry has, or rather does not have: the story of Juna's first winter. |
| [Feathers for a Small Hat](../quests/thimble_feathers_for_a_small_hat.md) | Side | 52 | [Thimble](../npcs/thimble.md) | Thimble has secretly kept the grandee hat's trimmings in case a smaller hat is ever wanted. | [The Late Egg Cart](../quests/knox_the_late_egg_cart.md) | Side | 14 | [Knox](../npcs/knox.md) | Knox knows every regular on the Walkers' Road, and the egg woman's cart is two days late. Clear the stack rats round the Halfway Stone so she can come through. |
| [Proof for the Notebook](../quests/tick_proof_for_the_notebook.md) | Side | 15 | [Tick](../npcs/tick.md) | A traveler told Tick about a ford whose water ran backwards for an evening, and the pool octopi at the Halfway Stone have been crawling out of their pools ever since. | [Eyes by the Stackyards](../quests/dagny_eyes_by_the_stackyards.md) | Side | 16 | [Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe](../npcs/dagny_roe.md) | Dagny sees pairs of eyes in the dark beyond the road every night now, low in the stackyards below the gate. | [Meadow Herbs](../quests/patch_meadow_herbs.md) | Side | 16 | [Patch](../npcs/patch.md) | Patch's jars are emptying and Brindle will not let her into the fields alone. Thin out the verge adders in the Gate Meadows and bring back 10 bundles of the herbs they nest in. |
| [The Wool Carts](../quests/torvi_the_wool_carts.md) | Side | 17 | [Torvi Brask](../npcs/torvi_brask.md) | The highland wool carters are late, stuck on the rotten boardwalks of the Seepwater Foothills where the bog-lurchers have come up out of the reeds. Torvi asks you to clear 30 of them. |
| [The Highland Traveler](../quests/knox_the_highland_traveler.md) | Side | 18 | [Knox](../npcs/knox.md) | The old button-seller from the highlands walks down Stonefang Pass every season, and he has not come. | [A Count for the Slate](../quests/brindle_a_count_for_the_slate.md) | Side | 18 | [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md) | Brindle keeps a weekly slate of sightings by the gate, and Stonefang Pass has gone uncounted since the carters stopped reporting. | [The Night Watch](../quests/brindle_the_night_watch.md) | Story | 20 | [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md) | Brindle asks you to stand the night watch at the gate beside Dagny, then go down into the Outworks at dusk and hunt the gloomeyes whose eyes she sees in the dark. |
| [Morning Prints](../quests/dagny_morning_prints.md) | Story | 21 | [Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe](../npcs/dagny_roe.md) | Every morning there are prints in the dust by the road below the gate. | [Bite Herbs](../quests/patch_bite_herbs.md) | Story | 24 | [Patch](../npcs/patch.md) | The lampbats' bites go bad if they are not cleaned, and Patch's jar of bite-cleaning herb is empty. It grows only in the Outworks' ditches, where the ditch rats drag it into their nests. Bring her 15 sprigs. |
| [Under the Fallen Tower](../quests/brindle_under_the_fallen_tower.md) | Story | 28 | [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md) | The lampbats roost under the Fallen Tower, and something leads them. Talk with Lux about what lives in the flooded vault, then come back to Brindle to plan the way in. |
| [The Gloamwing](../quests/brindle_the_gloamwing.md) | Story | 28 | [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md) | Go into the flooded vault under the Fallen Tower and defeat the Gloamwing, the Disturbance-touched bat that leads the lampbats against the outer lanterns. Brindle will open the way. |
| [The Wanderer's Story](../quests/tick_the_wanderers_story.md) | Story | 20 | [Tick](../npcs/tick.md) | Tick's notebook holds the story of a frightened wanderer who sheltered in a tunnel mouth in the hills, followed it underground and came out running with a stone that would not cool. | [A Way In](../quests/brindle_a_way_in.md) | Story | 20 | [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md) | If a tunnel runs under Old Grad's walls, it is a way into the city that no gate guards. Brindle will not act on it alone: take it to Rook, the Caller of the Open Table. |

| [What Seraphine Saw](../quests/barnaby_what_seraphine_saw.md) | Story | 61 | [Barnaby](../npcs/barnaby.md) | Barnaby wants Seraphine to see the scored keel timber. She has refused to describe what she saw in the deep water to anyone. |
| [Checking the Marks](../quests/ambrose_checking_the_marks.md) | Story | 63 | [Ambrose](../npcs/ambrose_chartmaker.md) | Ambrose's newest marks lie under the headland. From the Holm Wood's Old Fellings and the Rim, where the pale light comes up through the trees, they can be checked. |
| [The Ledge She Was Reaching For](../quests/nerissa_the_ledge.md) | Story | 65 | [Nerissa](../npcs/nerissa.md) | Nerissa stopped diving after something moved below the shelf at the reef's edge. She asks for a pearl from the ledge she was reaching for, and then she will tell. |
| [To See It Once](../quests/tristram_to_see_it_once.md) | Story | 67 | [Tristram](../npcs/tristram.md) | Tristram wants to see the thing in the deep water once, with his own eyes, not to kill it. Go with him at night to the rim of the Lantern Deep. |
| [The Deep Lantern](../quests/harbour_master_quenna_the_deep_lantern.md) | Story | 68 | [Quenna](../npcs/harbour_master_quenna.md) | The Harbour Master takes it to the council. The thing in the sea-hole has a name now, and the harbour asks you to put it down. |
| [In Ink, Not in the Margin](../quests/ysolde_ink_not_margin.md) | Side | 69 | [Ysolde](../npcs/ysolde.md) | With the Deep Lantern gone, Ysolde writes the lights into the lighthouse log properly. She wants you there. |
| [The Council Hears It](../quests/harbour_master_quenna_the_council_hears_it.md) | Side | 70 | [Quenna](../npcs/harbour_master_quenna.md) | The harbour council wants to thank you, loudly, as Quenna promised. Each of them wants a word. |
| [Birds for Miss Maren](../quests/ossie_birds_for_the_logbook.md) | Side | 58 | [Ossie](../npcs/ossie.md) | Ossie wants Maren to see the bird page of his logbook. He is shy about it. |
| [The Ledger of Tales](../quests/delphine_the_ledger_of_tales.md) | Side | 58 | [Delphine](../npcs/delphine.md) | Delphine has thought for years of showing her ledger of sea tales to Ambrose. Now that the drawer is open, she asks you to take it. |

| [Welts in the Casebook](../quests/clemence_welts_in_the_casebook.md) | Side | 60 | [Clemence](../npcs/clemence.md) | Clemence wants to compare the round welts in her casebook with the hooks of salt mist the shades leave behind. |
| [At the Wheel](../quests/morwenna_the_wheel.md) | Side | 62 | [Morwenna](../npcs/morwenna.md) | Morwenna had the Saltlark's wheel the night the keel was brushed. She has not told her mother or her son. Now she wants to. |
| [A Blank Chart](../quests/captain_seraphine_a_blank_chart.md) | Side | 63 | [Seraphine](../npcs/captain_seraphine.md) | Seraphine keeps a blank chart sheet in her cabin for waters past Ambrose's charts. Now she wants Ambrose to have what she saw. |
| [A Schoolhouse, One Day](../quests/maren_a_schoolhouse_one_day.md) | Side | 60 | [Maren](../npcs/maren.md) | Maren brings the children's work to every council meeting and asks for a schoolhouse. This year she has a lesson about the Old Cut to show them. |
| [The New Marks](../quests/poppy_the_new_marks.md) | Side | 64 | [Poppy](../npcs/poppy.md) | Poppy has drawn every new mark Ambrose put on the chart as you reported them. She wants him to see her copy. |
| [Twine for the Saltlark](../quests/wenna_twine_for_the_saltlark.md) | Side | 50 | [Wenna](../npcs/wenna.md) | The Saltlark's nets need mending before she sails deep again, and Wenna needs twine from Wilmot's rope walk. |
| [Watch Bounty: The Holm Wood](../quests/jowan_watch_bounty_holm_wood.md) | Repeatable | 55 | [Jowan](../npcs/jowan.md) | The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the Holm Wood's dusk wolves and lanternshades, again and again. |
| [A Touched Shade](../quests/tristram_touched_shade.md) | Repeatable | 57 | [Tristram](../npcs/tristram.md) | Tristram pays for every Disturbance-touched creature put down in the Holm Wood. |
| [The Stamp](../quests/hobart_the_stamp.md) | Story | 20 | [Hobart](../npcs/hobart.md) | Hobart has four iron-bound crates in the back of the oldest warehouse that nobody has ever claimed, and a stamp burned into their lids that nobody can name. |
| [Every Plank of Her](../quests/kenwyn_every_plank.md) | Story | 20 | [Kenwyn](../npcs/kenwyn.md) | Kenwyn draws you a map of the Saltgrace and sends you down the salvagers' steps to see her mark with your own eyes. |
| [The Purser's Strongbox](../quests/kenwyn_the_pursers_strongbox.md) | Story | 22 | [Kenwyn](../npcs/kenwyn.md) | A trading ship's purser kept her papers in an iron strongbox. Kenwyn knows where the Saltgrace's is, and what the mimics have made of the Holds around it. |

| [The Long Way Home](../quests/lorcan_the_long_way_home.md) | Side | 22 | [Lorcan](../npcs/lorcan.md) | Lorcan has heard that Wilmot has found the last verse of 'The Long Way Home', and he wants it sung at the Salt and Bread by the man who remembers the tune. |
| [The Holdfast](../quests/kenwyn_the_holdfast.md) | Story | 24 | [Kenwyn](../npcs/kenwyn.md) | Kenwyn finally tells you what he saw in the Saltgrace's lowest hold this spring, and why the whole ship creaks. |

Go out to the last stump on the Forest Shore, defeat 50 Strand Foxes on the Strandwood Rocks and bring him 12 Fox Sinews. Not a word to Hamish. |
| [Knock Twice](../quests/osric_knock_twice.md) | Side | 26 | [Osric](../npcs/osric_woodsman.md) | Osric keeps the old woodsmen's sayings. Put down 40 Driftstumps near the crews, then knock twice on the last stump on the Forest Shore. |
| [Brodie's Favour](../quests/sorcha_brodies_favour.md) | Side | 26 | [Sorcha](../npcs/sorcha_fisher.md) | Two winters ago Sorcha let Brodie have a season's catch on credit, and he has never repaid it. Ask him about the favour, then bring Sorcha what he needs. |
| [Sound Grain](../quests/tamsin_sound_grain.md) | Side | 26 | [Tamsin](../npcs/tamsin_boatwright.md) | Tamsin blames the Gap Runner's losses on her timber. Bring her 20 Sound Driftwood from the Driftstumps of the Strandwood so she can read the grain. |

| [Mhairi's Song](../quests/cormac_mhairis_song.md) | Side | 28 | [Cormac](../npcs/cormac_singer.md) | Cormac is hurt that his old pupil Mhairi has not asked him for a verse of her race song. Ask her, lightly, how it goes, and bring him 15 Fox Sinews for a set of old camp fiddle strings. |
| [Agna's Knots](../quests/eilidh_agnas_knots.md) | Side | 28 | [Eilidh](../npcs/eilidh_child.md) | Eilidh wants to tie a knot her grandmother will call better than "not bad". Look at Kestra's knots on the highest bridge, ask Agna what makes them good, and bring Eilidh 20 Fox Sinews for line. |
| [Paid in Sinew](../quests/esk_paid_in_sinew.md) | Side | 28 | [Esk](../npcs/esk_adventurer.md) | Esk owes Gwenna, who will not take her coin. Bring Esk 20 Fox Sinew, which Gwenna uses to whip her rope ends. |
| [A Collar for Ma](../quests/jory_a_collar_for_ma.md) | Side | 28 | [Jory](../npcs/jory_crew.md) | Jory's mother writes that the inland winters are cold, which means her back hurts. Bring Jory 20 Strand Fox Tails to trade with Greer for a fur collar. |
| [Clean Prints](../quests/kenna_clean_prints.md) | Side | 28 | [Kenna](../npcs/kenna_hunter.md) | Someone small follows the hunters to the last stump. Kenna wants the foxes thinned near the edge, and the prints in the mud there kept clear. |
